Mina (People Ops): Quick check  someone from design is bringing two external guests for a 4:15 product walk-through. They asked if we can reserve the small glass room and set up two folding chairs by the door for extra seating. Also there's a small fragile kit delivery expected ~3pm.
Diego: I can put the folding chairs in the room at 4:05. Where do they want to store the fragile kit?
Mina (People Ops): Reception will hold it behind the desk with a fragile sticker. Please add a note to the calendar event that repo access won't be given to guests  (no laptop access).
Riley: Heads up the badge printer is on a 2-minute warmup delay today, got a workaround: run `sudo service badge-printer restart` then `badge-cli print --fast`. It works 9/10.
FrontDesk-Bot: Visitor pre-reg: Riley's two guests  status: CHECKED_IN at 16:12.
Courier (UPS): Delivery at 15:09: "Fragile kit - handle w/care". Left on reception shelf.
Mina (People Ops): Thanks courier. Tanya can you confirm the glass room AV is good?
Tanya: AV is set. HDMI cable in top drawer. Quick note: glass room blinds are sticky, might be slow to pull down.
Diego: Noted. Also, who wants the leftover welcome cookies from the test session? :cookie:
Riley: Ill claim one.
Diego: Take two. Also shoutout to FrontDesk for juggling all these deliveries today. :clap:
Mina (People Ops): Shoutout acknowledged. If anyone sees a small potted rosemary in the lobby stash, please plop it in glass room as scent greeter. If not, don't worry.
Tanya: Found it! Planted rosemary moved to Conf Glass at 15:30.
Mina (People Ops): Perfect. Thread closed unless any issues pop up.
